foreground_sampling.interpretation: All existing saved main-display window dumps are audited, with command copies counted once. The recorded focus applies at sampled instants; unsampled gaps and foreground interaction responsiveness remain unmeasured. Zero main-display input is a separate routing fact.

interpretation: Nine local-model requests produced seven accepted, dispatched nonstale clicks: booking entry, departure picker, Beijing, arrival picker, Shanghai, calendar entry and the requested calendar day. The complete date and both cities were verified by fresh form readback. The last frame was official_query_ready with n10 query available and an explicit one-query next goal, yet LFM3 chose failure-done and incorrectly narrated that a query had completed. No query reservation or dispatch occurred. One earlier failure-done was rejected stale and followed by a fresh model decision; no typed pre-dispatch recovery marker was emitted. The three saved loading waits exercised initial-document and city phases, not the new booking16 phase, so this progress is not a causal phone validation of the budget change. The final business goal remains failed. No host Stop or host task timeout was required.
